description.text: Why choosing this program? The university’s discipline of architecture takes the leading position home and abroad and keeps an increasing influence in the world. The graduates, including some prominent members of the Academy of Engineering of China and many noted experts, have contributed a lot to the development of architecture. Main Courses Fundamentals of Architectural Design, The Principle of Architecture Design, History of Chinese and Foreign Architecuture, Building Structure and Architectural Mechanics, Building Construction etc. Internship Graduates will have many practical teaching, including art practice, site practice, construction practice of surveying and mapping, practice of knowing architecture, design institute production practice. After this program study, students can work as a designer in design departments and become advanced engineering technicians. DegreeAwarded bachelor degreee

duration.text: The Architecture at Weifang University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1388 USD/per year ￥ 10000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3. High school's certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. The acceptable applicants include students sent by the foreign educational institutions and legal non-governmental organizations and self-paid individuals from foreign countries 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 3. Applicants must Be in good health
